status: VERIFIED CLAIM SET — every figure independently recomputed from raw unit artifacts

verification.note: the central contrast was rebuilt from candidate_revalidation rows through the frozen factor model with an independent dominance filter and 2-D hypervolume sweep, reproducing all 480 published per-unit values to 0.000e+00

CORRECTION_1_non_finite.withdrawn_claim: zero non-finite values in any artifact
CORRECTION_1_non_finite.why_it_was_wrong: the completeness sweep iterated runner.STAGES, which does NOT contain metrics_by_method.json, so the indicator blocks were never examined
CORRECTION_1_non_finite.correct_statement: 140 non-finite cells exist, all of them spacing and spacing_cv on the 70 method-by-reference blocks whose front has ONE point. Schott spacing is undefined without at least two gaps; NaN is the correct value, not a defect, and those units are excluded from spacing summaries rather than propagated through a median

CORRECTION_2_boundary_control.withdrawn_phrasing: the geometry contrast is null on Spambase because there is no interior geometry for it to act on
CORRECTION_2_boundary_control.why_it_overstates: Spambase's geometry difference has median +0.0500 -- LARGER than MAGIC's significant +0.0374 -- with sd 1.7706 against MAGIC's 0.0594, a ~30x dispersion. The null is a failure to resolve at R = 30, not a demonstrated absence of effect
CORRECTION_2_boundary_control.also: 'Spambase's design-row front has two points' is the PRE-CAMPAIGN screening value. Across the 30 confirmatory replications that front is median 3, range 2-5, and exactly 2 in 9 of 30
CORRECTION_2_boundary_control.correct_statement: the geometry contrast is NOT RESOLVABLE on Spambase at R = 30. That is consistent with the pre-specified reasoning about a degenerate reference front, and the pre-specification is what licenses reporting it separately, but it does not demonstrate that the mechanism is absent there

OTHER_CAVEATS.estimand: every primary claim is about the returned FRONT, not about a deployed configuration. The holdout stage measures internal-versus-holdout optimism and was never designed to rank arms

indicator_specificity.note: the geometry effect is a hypervolume-and-IGD+ effect. Joint non-dominated fraction shows no significant difference on ANY dataset, so a general better-coverage claim is not supported

OTHER_CAVEATS.gate_regime: the Adult and Bank Marketing geometry results were obtained where the composite-quality gate passes in 0 of 30 replications. The effect is therefore not conditional on a passing surrogate -- a strength, but one to state plainly rather than leave implicit
OTHER_CAVEATS.anchor_injection: C7 holds for medians and signs. The control set is a SUPERSET of NBI-S's, so its effect is non-negative by construction; it is nonzero in 29/30 MAGIC units. The claim is that set composition explains none of the gap in the median, not that it is identically zero
OTHER_CAVEATS.budget_double_count: 396,120 logical evaluations ALREADY includes the unmatched NSGA-II charge inside the four rep_00 ledgers. Adding the manifest's 15,360 again gives 411,480 and is wrong. Logical (396,120) and unique physical (377,316, 4.75% cache) are distinct and only the logical figure enters fairness
OTHER_CAVEATS.frozen_factor_model: factor_model.json differs byte-for-byte across the 30 replications of a dataset because it carries per-replication diagnostics including the refit sensitivity. The 15 MODEL-DEFINING fields are invariant, one hash per dataset. State the qualifier
OTHER_CAVEATS.spambase_not_globally_null: Spambase's anchor-provenance contrast IS strongly negative and significant (median -0.6932, 5/30, Holm 0.00057) and its historical reconstruction gap is the panel's largest. It is excluded from the primary family, not from the findings
